set(PluginName "MP_Pipeline")
# the slave executable sits next to the plugin: <plugin file name>.slave.exe
set(SlaveName "${PluginName}_slave")

include("Files.cmake")

# The filter parameter headers (*.def.h) are generated by gen_filter_def.py, like in the Visual
# Studio pre-build step; it rewrites a header only when its content changes. The generated
# headers are committed: without Python they are used as they are.
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter)
if(Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
  add_custom_target(filter_defs
    COMMAND Python3::Interpreter "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/gen_filter_def.py"
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
    COMMENT "Generating the filter definition headers")
else()
  message(STATUS "No Python 3: the committed *.def.h files are used")
endif()

# --- the plugin ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_library(${PluginName} SHARED ${MP_Pipeline_Sources} "lib.def")

set_target_properties(${PluginName} PROPERTIES "OUTPUT_NAME" "${PluginName}")
if(MINGW)
  set_target_properties(${PluginName} PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
  set_target_properties(${PluginName} PROPERTIES IMPORT_PREFIX "")
endif()
target_link_libraries(${PluginName} PRIVATE rpcrt4)

# --- the slave process --------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(${SlaveName} ${MP_Pipeline_Slave_Sources})
set_target_properties(${SlaveName} PROPERTIES "OUTPUT_NAME" "${PluginName}.dll.slave")
target_link_libraries(${SlaveName} PRIVATE psapi rpcrt4)

# version resources
enable_language(RC)
target_sources(${PluginName} PRIVATE "AVS_SplitProcess.rc")
target_sources(${SlaveName} PRIVATE "SplitProcess_Slave.rc")

foreach(target ${PluginName} ${SlaveName})
  target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
  if(TARGET filter_defs)
    add_dependencies(${target} filter_defs)
  endif()
  if(MINGW)
    # the C++ runtime (libstdc++ or libc++), libgcc / libunwind and winpthreads are linked
    # statically: the files depend only on system DLLs and the C runtime
    target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -static)
  endif()
endforeach()

# Automatically group source files according to directory structure
foreach(FILE ${MP_Pipeline_Sources})
  get_filename_component(PARENT_DIR "${FILE}" PATH)

  string(REGEX REPLACE "(\\./)" "" GROUP "${PARENT_DIR}")
  string(REPLACE "/" "\\" GROUP "${GROUP}")

  # group into "Source Files" and "Header Files"
  if("${FILE}" MATCHES ".*\\.cpp")
    set(GROUP "Source Files\\${GROUP}")
  elseif("${FILE}" MATCHES ".*\\.h")
    set(GROUP "Header Files\\${GROUP}")
  endif()

  source_group("${GROUP}" FILES "${FILE}")
endforeach()

install(TARGETS ${PluginName} ${SlaveName}
        RUNTIME DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}")
